A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed approach is able to segment liver lesions in 3-D volumes with a high accuracy and robustness.

the use of deep ResNet architectures with skip connections is a promising approach for liver lesion segmentation.
deep residual networks can be used to learn more discriminant features to improve the segmentation of liver lesions.
